origin_issue.title: [BACKEND] [STORY] Estimate: Present Estimate Summary for Review

clarification_issue.title: [CLARIFICATION] Origin #169: [BACKEND] [STORY] Estimate: Present Estimate Summary for Review

clarifications_resolved.question: If required legal terms and disclaimers are not configured in the system, should the summary generation fail with an error (as assumed in this story), or should it proceed with a warning/default text?
clarifications_resolved.decision: Use immutable snapshots; if legal terms are missing, handle gracefully per policy (fail or use defaults) with clear documentation.

interpretation.immutable_snapshots: System SHALL use immutable snapshots of estimate data when generating summaries
interpretation.legal_terms_capture: Legal terms and disclaimers SHALL be captured as part of the snapshot
interpretation.configurable_policy: Handling of missing legal terms SHALL be configurable per business policy
policy_options: FAIL (safe default): Prevent summary generation if legal terms are not configured
USE_DEFAULTS: Generate summary with system-configured default legal terms
interpretation.documentation_requirement: The chosen policy MUST be clearly documented and configurable
interpretation.audit_requirement: All snapshots MUST include timestamp and configuration state for audit purposes
